# HexPiece 3.3.3

Rubber World's waves, after your note on 3.3.2. Not tested in game yet: the build and all tests pass, and the ground was rendered and
checked over a whole field's life.

**Rubber World (M in Gear 5)**
- The waves are much slower: the first rings roll out at about 5 to 6 blocks a second (they went 15), and the waves after them at
  2.4 to 4 blocks a second (they went more than 8).
- Every wave is its own size: some low ripples, some much bigger swells up to two blocks high, each its own width and speed, so the
  ground heaves unevenly like slime.
- The big swells are the ones that throw everyone else about; the small ones roll under their feet.
- Gear 5's jump ripples are unchanged.
